title: AHB Wait-State Domino Effect
description: An INCR4 write burst shows how a stalled data phase freezes the following address phase and delays every later beat.

annotations.message: Address beat 1 starts the INCR4 write at 0x50. No data phase exists yet.
Write payload W0 for 0x50 is stalled by HREADY=0. Address 0x54 is visible but pending, so its complete context and W0 must hold.
HREADY rises: W0 for 0x50 completes and the held 0x54 address is accepted at the same edge.
W1 for 0x54 completes without a wait while address 0x58 is accepted.
W2 for 0x58 stalls. Address 0x5C becomes the pending next address phase.
The second wait cycle continues. Address 0x5C, HTRANS=SEQ, and W2 all remain stable.
HREADY rises: W2 for 0x58 completes and the held 0x5C address is accepted.
W3 completes for 0x5C while an IDLE address/control cycle is visible. The fourth accepted beat finishes the INCR4 burst.
